title: Length of the Credit Relationship and the Move-Up Entry Gate
content:
**Service level terms — Ship-To Fulfillment Account: customers of long standing.**

The next level's entry gate is applied at a share set by how long the customer has held its Commercial Credit Account, in whole months from the account's opened date to the request date: at 95 percent for at least 120 months, at 97 percent for at least 60 and fewer than 120 months, and in full for a shorter tenure or where the customer has no such account or its account has no opened date.

Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.

| Whole months the Commercial Credit Account has been held | Share of the gate applied |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 95 percent |
| 60 to 119 | 97 percent |
| fewer than 60, no account, or no opened date | in full |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical):** an account opened on the 12th of a month and a request on the 12th of the month 120 calendar months later: 120 whole months, 95 percent; on the 11th of that month: 119 whole months, 97 percent. 60 whole months: 97 percent; 59: in full.

The opened date is the date shown on the customer's Commercial Credit Account as the date it was approved and opened.
